business_summary: Excelerate Energy, Inc. (NYSE: EE) owns and commercially operates the industry's largest floating storage and regasification unit (FSRU) fleet, twelve units. It sits on the hormuz-maritime chain's lng-shipping-and-qatari-supply link: FSRUs are how import markets replace pipeline and Qatari cargo volumes cargo by cargo when Gulf throughput is constrained. SEC companyfacts gives revenue, operating income, depreciation and current-dated debt and cash cleanly, but carries no net_income_fy or capex_fy series at all for this filer, blocking cash conversion and reverse-DCF.
